svg.title: Exercise selection DFD – reorganised
svg.desc: Top-down dataflow: User sends requests to four processes (Browse, Search, Filter, Order) that each read from the Exercises table and return results to the user.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What fields does the exercises table contain?')
sendPrompt('How does search by name work?')
sendPrompt('What categories can exercises be filtered by?')
sendPrompt('What inputs does the user provide?')
